title: Subject record
description: A content-addressed identity/provenance record: an immutable, hash-verified statement about one subject, with a version history that must be provenance-backed. See ../README.md for the invariants this schema alone cannot express (hash recomputation, provenance-chain matching, non-self-attestation) — those are enforced by validate-soul-space.js.

subject_id.description: Stable identifier for the subject this record describes.

attributes.description: Freeform, domain-defined fields describing the subject. This is the extension point: a concrete deployment replaces or extends this with its own vocabulary.

attestation.description: Optional. A third-party verification claim about this record. Absent unless verifier_provenance is populated — a record cannot carry an attestation with no evidence of who made it.

verifier_id.description: Must identify a party other than the subject itself. Checked by the validator, not by this schema alone — see G4 in validate-soul-space.js.

content_hash.description: Recomputed by the validator, never author-supplied as authority.
